Outcome.DescriptionText: A man in a Starfleet uniform that does not quite fit appears on the bridge, hands you a crate and vanishes. Inside are five hundred credits in a currency nobody has seen before. Research Continuum Studies to follow this lead up.
The planet below is suddenly a different shape. Q finds this very funny. Research Continuum Studies to follow this lead up.
Q projects a lecture across every viewscreen in the fleet. It is rude, well-timed, and unquestionably correct. Research Continuum Studies to follow this lead up.
